title: Space Telegram (Run-Length Encoding)
hints: Encoding: walk the string with an index i; find where the run of equal characters ends (j), emit s[i] and the run length (j - i), then continue from j.
Decoding: read one letter, then read all the digits that follow and build the number with n = n * 10 + (ch - '0').
Use std::string::append(count, ch) to add a character count times.
